# claude-skill-successfactors-jobs-api

A Claude agent skill that drives the [SAP SuccessFactors Jobs API](https://apify.com/johnvc/sap-successfactors-jobs-api?fpr=9n7kx3&fp_sid=skillrepo) Apify Actor.

Pull live SAP SuccessFactors job postings to a structured feed.

## Install

```bash
npx skills add johnisanerd/claude-skill-successfactors-jobs-api
```

Or add the `apify-successfactors-jobs-api/` folder to your agent's skills directory. The skill lives in [`apify-successfactors-jobs-api/SKILL.md`](./apify-successfactors-jobs-api/SKILL.md).

## What it does

The skill calls the Actor, which reads the public jobs feed that SAP SuccessFactors career sites publish and returns structured JSON. No key needed for the public jobs layer, billed per job delivered.
